hypotheses.what: The generated contractless formatter writes different bytes than ContractlessStandardResolver for attribute-bearing members.
hypotheses.finding: Output is equal. Both write a member marked [IgnoreDataMember]; this is shared exposure behaviour, not a divergence. It still goes to the owner as R-2129-2.

hypotheses.what: Read-only and private-setter public members are dropped with no diagnostic.
hypotheses.finding: Wire output is {"Id":1} for ProbeRoType; the built-in contractless output is identical, so this matches existing behaviour but is silent.

hypotheses.what: Duplicate formatter requests for one type, or a formatter for a type that already has [MessagePackObject], leave a formatter without a body.
hypotheses.finding: CS0535 on ProbeDupFormatterB and ProbeAttrTypeFormatter. No MsgPack diagnostic explains the conflict.

hypotheses.what: init-only and required members fail to round trip.
hypotheses.finding: InitAndRequiredRoundTrip passes; output equals the built-in resolver.

hypotheses.what: The router reads the whole 1043-line change because Attributes.cs is in the MessagePack.Annotations runtime area, which has an L3 ceiling.
hypotheses.finding: The ceiling rule is path-based. The Annotations hunk is a 36-line additive attribute class, while the other 1007 lines sit in the generator, tests and docs. See LESSONS.

hypotheses.what: The execution tests cannot run under the SDK pinned in global.json.
hypotheses.finding: SDK 8.0.402 ships Roslyn 4.11 and the generator needs 4.12 (CS9057), on base and head. Under SDK 9.0.321 the same tests run. The pin predates the change.

hypotheses.what: An [IgnoreMember] attribute on a member of the formatted type is ignored by the generated formatter (raised by Gemini, C3).
hypotheses.finding: Output is {"X":1,"Y":2}: the ignored member is written. Supports refusal R-2129-4.

hypotheses.what: A [MessagePackFormatter] custom formatter on a surrogate member is silently ignored (raised by Gemini, NEW1; Claude's claims and prosecutor missed it).
hypotheses.finding: Wire output is [21]; the custom doubling formatter would give [42]. CreateMember passes CustomFormatter: null. Goes to the owner as R-2129-6.
